variants.headline: Party leader blunders in election debate
variants.body: A party leader has blundered in an election debate. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.

variants.headline: A debate brings a leader's misstep
variants.body: An election debate has included a blunder by a party leader. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.

variants.headline: Election argument meets an awkward moment
variants.body: A party leader has made a misstep in an election debate. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.
